scientific_summary: For two iid draws from three equally spaced atoms, the correlation of the sample minimum and maximum is at most 8/19 over all nondegenerate probability weights, with equality uniquely at the uniform law; every positive correlation up to 8/19 is attainable with full support.
limitations: Specific to three equally spaced support points, sample size two, and the extreme order-statistic pair; no claim is made for larger supports, other order pairs, arbitrary support locations, nonlinear maximal correlation, or sampling without replacement; older or differently indexed equivalent formulations remain a residual originality risk.
